headword: {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}

definitions.gloss: document creation; document preparation; drafting documents
definitions.explanation: The act of writing, composing, or producing official or formal documents such as reports, contracts, proposals, and correspondence.

examples.japanese: {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}に{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to prepare the document.

examples.japanese: {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}ソフトを{使|つか}って{報告書|ほうこくしょ}を{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote the report using a word processing application.

examples.japanese: {契約書|けいやくしょ}の{文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}は{法務部|ほうむぶ}が{担当|たんとう}している。
examples.english: The legal department handles the preparation of contracts.

notes:
A compound of {文書|ぶんしょ} (document; written text) and {作成|さくせい} (creation; preparation). A key term in office and administrative work. Can be used with する as a verb ({文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}する).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}ソフト: word processing software
- {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}{能力|のうりょく}: document writing ability
- {公文書|こうぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}: preparation of official documents
- {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}{業務|ぎょうむ}: document preparation work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {文章|ぶんしょう}{作成|さくせい}: writing composition — broader, includes any written text, not just formal documents
- {起案|きあん}: drafting; proposal writing — more formal, specifically about creating initial drafts for approval
- {書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}: paperwork preparation — similar but emphasizes the paper-based nature of the documents
